items.n: Arrive at main gate security by 7:00 AM for 8:00 AM opening. Get the group through bag check and turnstiles together; allow extra time for 9 people.

items.n: Quick pastries, coffee, and drinks. Walk from Toontown to Main Street. No mobile order needed; order at counter and grab a patio seat.

Walk from Fantasyland through Frontierland to Galaxy's Edge Marketplace. Typical wait is minimal. Must-do for this group.
Quick-service lunch in Galaxy's Edge. Order Fried Endorian Tip-Yip or Felucian Kefta. Eat at the counter or nearby seating. Off-peak for this venue.
Two easy shots near your lunch spot: Black Spire Outpost path with Batuu rock spires behind, and Millennium Falcon plaza with the full ship behind you.
Walk from Galaxy's Edge to the main gate (~10 min), pass through security screening (~5 min), and enter Disney California Adventure. Total ~15 min.
Starbucks-style snacks and drinks. Quick grab-and-go near the DCA entry. Coordinate with s16 timing or grab after Radiator Springs Racers.
